name: inspect-buttons-figure
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,pathlib,base64,json
p=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','2','-l','2','-singlefile','-scale-to','1400','-png','sources/buttons.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
s=base64.b64encode(p.stdout).decode();q=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/buttons-page2.png','--base64'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert q.returncode==0; print(s)
